description: Bootstrap a new EKS cluster from scratch with security baseline, observability, and backup enabled from day one. Must: provision EKS cluster via terraform, apply Pod Security Standards (restricted baseline), install cert-manager, install cluster-autoscaler, deploy Prometheus + Grafana, enable Velero backup with schedule, configure network policies (default deny + allow-list), and verify all components are healthy. No existing cluster to migrate from. Risk factors: security baseline too strict blocking workloads, missing network policy causing exposure, backup not verified before first deployment. Tools available: terraform, Helm, kubectl, aws CLI, Velero.
